raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions ignores the currency column, so the 85 EUR transactions are summed into the USD gold totals at face value. raw_fx_rates holds a rate_to_usd for EUR (1.25, a single as_of date that covers the whole period), so the amounts can be converted to USD reliably.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON t.currency = f.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
